note.name: Ethereum
note.horizonLabel: over the next 8 weeks, into the December Glamsterdam target
note.thesis: Ethereum's fee base is flat, the recent spike is one-off exploiter flow, supply is inflationary and ETH trades at 1,215× annualised fees against a 217× peer median. Crowded longs and a close at the 30-day low leave the 8-week risk to the downside.
note.what: Ethereum is a shared computer: thousands of independent nodes run the same smart-contract code, so programs can hold money and enforce rules without a company. ETH pays gas, is posted as a validator deposit under proof of stake, and is used as money and collateral, serving stablecoin rails, DeFi lenders, tokenised-asset issuers and rollups that settle to mainnet.

points.text: 30d fees were $18.52M, or $225.29M annualised. The 7d annualised $419.40M coincides with the exploiter dumping into 70,480 ETH, one-off flow rather than demand.

points.bold: Rich against the full peer set
points.text: ETH trades at 1,215.2× annualised fees and 3,096.7× annualised revenue. The peer median is 217.0× fees and 607.8× revenue; Tron is 109.8× on both.
ethwatch reads issuance of 3,008 ETH/day against a burn of 10 ETH/day, so net +2,998 ETH/day, or +0.9%/yr, with burn near zero.
The long/short account ratio is 3.30, with 77% of accounts long, while open interest across exchanges fell 4.8% to $5,263M over seven days.
Stablecoin and tokenised-asset balances raise ETH collateral and staking demand, and the revenue multiple ignores a monetary premium ZK-Labs itself calls undeterminable.

note.supplyHeadline: Fully unlocked, no cliffs, mildly inflationary
note.supplyText: DefiLlama shows 128.0M of 128.0M unlocked, no cliffs and no new tokens in the next 90 days. ethwatch (25 Oct 2026) reads total supply 122,161,213 ETH, issuance 3,008 ETH/day, burn 10 ETH/day and net +2,998 ETH/day, or +0.9%/yr. Staking inflation is not captured in the unlock schedule.
note.valuationText: For a chain, what matters is the base fee users pay and burn; ETH keeps little as protocol revenue. ETH trades at 1,215.2× annualised fees and 3,096.7× annualised revenue. The peer median is 217.0× fees and 607.8× revenue, so the premium is in the multiples, not the flows.
note.usageText: 30d fees were $18.52M, or $225.29M annualised, with 1y fees of $180.67M. The 7d annualised $419.40M coincides with the Binance exploiter moving 70,480 ETH, a one-off flow. Underlying L1 usage is flat, not accelerating.

catalysts.text: Foundation planning document targets Glamsterdam mainnet in this window; no formal date set.

risks.title: Fees re-accelerate organically
risks.text: A return to durable, non-exploiter fee growth would break the flat-usage call behind the verdict.

risks.title: Glamsterdam date confirmed
risks.text: A formal December mainnet date would lift the upper half of the range toward $2,587 and the $2,726 30d high.

risks.title: Exploiter overhang clears
risks.text: Disposal of the remaining 70,480 ETH without further selling removes the live supply overhang.

risks.title: Deflation is the true state
risks.text: If the -0.010%/yr issuance reading holds, the inflationary-supply argument behind the verdict fails.

watchlist.item: Late-October ETF flows claimed at -$60M and -$89M
Exploiter's remaining 70,480 ETH disposition; staking entry queue of 1,285,346 ETH activating

note.positioningText: Funding is +0.0100%/8h now, above the 7-day average of +0.0041%/8h, so longs pay shorts. The account long/short ratio is 3.30, with 77% long, while open interest fell 4.8% to $5,263M over seven days. Positioning is crowded long into falling momentum.
note.conclusion: Ethereum's L1 fee base is flat, the annualised spike follows a one-off exploiter flow, supply is inflationary and the multiple sits above the peer median. Momentum is negative, with price closing at its 30-day low, and positioning is crowded long. The evidence sits in the lower half of the 8-week range.
note.invalidation: Two weeks with 7d annualised fees above the 30d pace, excluding exploiter flow.
note.gaps: No current ETF flow data for late October; the claimed -$60M and -$89M are unverified. Exchange reserves conflict, 16M versus 10.52M. Issuance readings conflict, -0.010%/yr versus +0.9%/yr. Several whale, Foundation-transfer and Aave leads could not be checked.
